title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer regional failover race condition
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: During a recent partial regional outage we observed the SLO enforcer triggering multiple concurrent regional failovers for the same customer route. The root cause was a race between the failover coordinator and the per-region state reconciliation path: two independent controllers could observe the same degraded metrics window and both attempt failover, which temporarily doubled traffic to fallback regions and caused thrashing and SLA violations.

This hotfix makes failover initiation idempotent and serializes the critical section of the enforcer state machine to prevent duplicate failover attempts under high contention. It also adds metric tags to track duplicate attempts and a short-lived leader lease for a given customer/route to reduce coordination windows.

What I changed: - Add idempotency token to FailoverRequest and make the coordinator reject duplicate tokens for the same active window. - Introduce a lightweight per-route leadership lease (1s default) to serialize failover decisioning. - Guard state transitions with an atomic compare-and-swap in the enforcer runtime. - Add unit tests for concurrent failover attempts and an integration-level canary in the perf-canary harness. - Add metrics: slo.enforcer.failover.duplicate_attempts and slo.enforcer.leader_lease_acquired. - Update runbook note to include how to inspect duplicate_attempts and which alerts to silence during canary.

Risk and mitigation: This touches the core SLO enforcement path. Changes are implemented to be backward-compatible (new fields are optional) and default lease duration is conservative. We exercised the change in the staging canary (5% traffic) for 24 hours and validated no regressions in API latency or throughput.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduce race in unit/integration tests
- [x] Implement idempotency and leadership lease
- [x] Add metrics and dashboards
- [x] Run 24h canary on staging
- [x] Prepare runbook updates

Notes: Linear link ENG-4732 has the original investigation notes and load profiles. SUP-9812 filed by oncall documenting customer-facing impact.

review_comments: Amit Patel: Please add unit tests that simulate two concurrent controllers triggering failover — we should see only one successful failover and a metric increment for duplicate attempts.
Author (Maya Chen): Added concurrency_test.rs which reproduces the race and asserts idempotency. See commit d4f8c1e.
Diego Ruiz: Can we make the lease duration configurable via feature flag for emergency rollbacks? Also please ensure the change is backward-compatible for older agents.
Author (Maya Chen): Lease duration is configurable via env var SLO_ENFORCER_LEASE_MS and defaults to 1000ms. FailoverRequest idempotency token is optional to preserve compatibility.
Lauren Park: CI integration failed on first run due to a flakey perf-canary assertion; fixed by making timing assertions tolerant to clock jitter. Approved after CI pass.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent duplicate regional failover attempts caused by concurrent SLO enforcer decisioning. Adds idempotency tokens, a per-route leadership lease, metrics, and tests. Reduces risk of regional thrashing during partial outages.
slo_impact: Eliminates duplicate failover events and reduces failover-induced traffic thrashing; improves stability for customers during partial region degradation. Verified in 24h canary.
backout_instructions: Revert head branch or set SLO_ENFORCER_LEASE_MS=0 to disable leader lease; idempotency token is opt-in so older controllers will continue working. Follow runbook section 'slo-enforcer: rollback' for steps.
